title: Check the status of an MMM data request
content_data:
Use this endpoint to check the status of a Media Mix Modeling (MMM) data request. Once the `status` of the data request is `completed - ready for download`, you can use [/mmm/api/download/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-the-download-url-for-mmm-data/v1.3) to obtain a download URL for the data. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/mmm/api/check/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | mmm_request_id {Required} | string | Unique identifier for the MMM data request.

  • To create an MMM data request and obtain the data request ID, use [/mmm/api/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-an-mmm-data-request/v1.3).
  • To retrieve historical MMM data requests, including data request IDs, use [/mmm/api/history/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-the-mmm-data-request-history/v1.3).
| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/mmm/api/check/?mmm_request_id={{mmm_request_id}}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| status | string | Status of the data request.

Enum values:
  • `request received`: The request was received but data processing has not started.
  • `in progress`: Data processing is in progress.
  • `completed - ready for download`: Data processing has completed and the data is ready for download.
    • To obtain a download URL for the data, use [/mmm/api/download/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-the-download-url-for-mmm-data/v1.3).
  • `failed`: The request failed.
| #| message | string | Returned only when `status` is `failed`.

The reason why the data request failed. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "status": "completed - ready for download" } } (/code) ```
